capabilities: generate current and future sprint notes on a 1-8 week cadence, including catch-up after missed cycles
roll unfinished tasks over to the current sprint, backlog, or original sprint
manage tasks on project-grouped Kanban boards with drag-and-drop state changes and inline creation
plan and review sprints in a Sprint Planner and overview cards with dates, completed points, and review status
track completed story points per sprint in a velocity bar chart and install Claude Code agent skills
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later and the Bases core plugin enabled; complete setup and troubleshooting live in separate external guides. First setup creates tutorial projects and tasks, and the plugin states it does not send vault content over the network or invoke an AI model.
intentEvidence: provides task, sprint, velocity, and project views using Obsidian Bases
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to run sprint-based workflows: generating recurring sprints, rolling over unfinished tasks, and viewing work by project and sprint.

relations.evidence: It can install local skills that teach Claude Code and compatible agents how to create and manage projects

summary: Sprint planning plugin that generates sprint notes on a set cadence, rolls unfinished tasks forward, and adds Kanban, planner, and velocity views built on Bases.
